Test Description: This test verifies the GPIO register block by performing two checks: (1) Default Value Check — after reset, each GPIO per-pin register (gp0_gpio_8, gp0_gpio_9, gp0_gpio_10, and others in the register set) is read and compared against its expected default value using a read mask to isolate readable bits, with bit 0 (data_in) masked out since it reflects the live pin level. (2) Write/Read Verification — six different test patterns are written to each writable register and read back. The read-back value is compared against an expected value computed from the write mask, read mask, and default value to account for read-only and write-only fields. Registers flagged in the skip arrays are excluded from the respective checks. The test passes if all comparisons succeed and fails if any mismatch is detected.
Meta Test Description: The testcase contains two primary functions: chk_rst_val() and chk_rd_wr(), called from test_case(). chk_rst_val() iterates over addr_array[0..CNT-1] (CNT=49), where addr_array contains register address macros such as MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8, MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_9, MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_10 (base 0xA001A000 + offsets 0x0, 0x4, 0x8). For each register, if skip_rst_array[i]==1 the register is skipped; if read_mask_array[i]==0x00000000 the register is not readable and is skipped. Otherwise, data_rd = read_reg(addr) is called, then data = (data_rd & 0xfffffffe) masks out bit 0 (data_in pin level), and data is compared to default_value_array[i]. If mismatch, def_fail_cnt is incremented.
Remarks: Bit 0 (data_in) of each per-pin GPIO register is a read-only live pin-level input and is masked out during default value comparison using 0xFFFFFFFE. Registers with VRRW-type fields at certain offsets are skipped during write/read verification via the skip array. The soft reset check function is disabled via preprocessor conditional and is not executed.
Test Steps / Procedure: 1. Initialize the test environment and ensure the GPIO register block is in its post-reset default state. 2. Read each per-pin GPIO register and mask out the live pin-level input bit. 3. Compare each masked read value against the expected default value. 4. Record any default value mismatches. 5. Write test patterns to each writable GPIO register. 6. Read back each register and compute expected value. 7. Compare read-back value against computed expected value. 8. Repeat for remaining five test patterns. 9. Evaluate overall results.
Meta Test Steps / Procedure: 1. test_case() is called as the entry point. 2. chk_rst_val() is invoked: Loop i from 0 to CNT-1. 3. chk_rd_wr() is invoked with 6 test patterns. 4. If (def_fail_cnt > 0 || wr_fail_cnt > 0), call finish(1) — FAIL. Else finish(0) — PASS.
Validation / Acceptance Criteria: PASS: All per-pin GPIO registers return their expected default values after reset when read with bit 0 masked out, AND all six write test patterns are correctly retained. FAIL: Any mismatch causes the test to fail.
Meta Validation / Acceptance Criteria: chk_rst_val PASS condition: (read_reg(addr_array[i]) & 0xfffffffe) == default_value_array[i]. chk_rd_wr PASS condition: read-back matches computed expected value. Overall: finish(0) if all pass.

Test Description: This test verifies GPIO level-sensitive interrupt functionality for GPIO pin 8 (gp0_gpio_8). The test configures the GPIO pin in input mode and enables level-triggered interrupts through the per-pin register and the group interrupt enable register. It validates two scenarios: (1) Active-High Level Interrupt and (2) Active-Low Level Interrupt. The test passes if both interrupt scenarios complete successfully with correct status bits observed and cleared.
Meta Test Description: The testcase entry point is test_case(). It calls gpio_level_sel_intr_en(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8, 0, MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_EN1, MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_STS1). Configures level_sel, pedge_intr_en, enables group and LSS-level interrupts, triggers via SRAM stimulus, waits for GIC IRQ 87, verifies status bits, clears interrupt. Repeats for active-low.
Remarks: The test uses GIC IRQ 87 for GPIO0 (selected via #ifdef GPIO0). The SRAM address 0xA0243ffc is used as an external stimulus. The LSS system-level registers raw_stcr1 (offset 0x24) and intr_en1 (offset 0x28) are accessed. The gpio0_intr field is at bit[1] in both registers.
Test Steps / Procedure: 1. Configure GPIO pin 8 with level_sel=1 (active high). 2. Enable group interrupt. 3. Enable LSS system-level interrupt. 4. Drive GPIO pin 8 high. 5. Wait for GIC interrupt. 6-8. Verify status bits. 9. Clear interrupt. 10. Reconfigure for active low. 11-15. Repeat and verify.
Meta Test Steps / Procedure: 1. test_case() called. 2. gpio_level_sel_intr_en() invoked. 3. Active-High test with write_reg/read_reg sequence. 4. Active-Low test. 5. finish(0) if pass, finish(1) if fail.
Validation / Acceptance Criteria: PASS: For both scenarios: GIC interrupt received, intr_raw_sts set, group intr_sts set, LSS raw_stcr1 set, interrupt cleared successfully. FAIL: Any condition not met.
Meta Validation / Acceptance Criteria: Active-High: (read_reg(addr) >> 1) & 1 == 1 AND group sts set AND LSS sts set. Active-Low: same checks. Overall: finish(0) if all pass.
